label: At w, a power for p is a power for any q holding at every accessible p-world
paraphrase: OPEN bridge (analyst formulation, unattributed): at w, for every being y and propositions p and q, if q holds at every world accessible from w at which p holds, then a PowerFor of y at w for p is a PowerFor of y at w for q. Reading: an exercise issuing in p obtaining issues in q obtaining. Cost: any power is then a power for whatever holds at every accessible world.
